epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys and settings for payment processing

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment form and validation
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form with input validation and error handling

tasks.title: Test payment processing and error handling
tasks.description: Verify successful payments, declined payments, and error handling scenarios

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Integrate Stripe subscription management for customers to manage their recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and payment methods
The system sends notifications to customers when their subscription is updated or cancelled

tasks.title: Implement subscription management UI and API integration
tasks.description: Create a user interface for customers to manage their subscriptions and integrate with Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription update and cancellation logic
tasks.description: Write code to handle subscription updates and cancellations, including payment method updates

tasks.title: Test subscription management and notification scenarios
tasks.description: Verify subscription updates, cancellations, and notification scenarios

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payment-related activities
stories.description: Integrate Stripe webhook for payment event handling and notification
acceptance_criteria: The system receives and processes payment event notifications from Stripe
The system generates receipts and sends email notifications for successful payments

tasks.title: Setup Stripe webhook for payment event notifications
tasks.description: Configure Stripe webhook settings and API endpoint for payment event handling

tasks.title: Develop payment event handling and notification logic
tasks.description: Write code to handle payment event notifications, generate receipts, and send email notifications

tasks.title: Test payment event handling and notification scenarios
tasks.description: Verify payment event handling, receipt generation, and email notification scenarios

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access my account securely
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, with proper validation and error handling
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user credentials correctly and allows login with valid email and password
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email or password
The system redirects the user to the dashboard after successful login

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation logic
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate user credentials and handle login requests

tasks.title: Create login page with email and password fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the login page with email and password input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate login functionality with backend API
tasks.description: Write API calls to handle login requests and integrate with the backend validation logic

stories.title: As a new user, I want to sign up for an account, so that I can use the system's features
stories.description: The system should allow new users to sign up for an account, with proper validation and email verification
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user input data correctly and creates a new account with valid data
The system sends a verification email to the user's email address after signup
The system displays an error message when the user enters invalid or duplicate data

tasks.title: Implement user input validation logic for signup
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate user input data and handle signup requests

tasks.title: Create signup page with user input fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the signup page with user input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate signup functionality with email verification API
tasks.description: Write API calls to handle signup requests and integrate with the email verification service

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account when I forget my password
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, with proper validation and email notification
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user input data correctly and sends a password reset email with valid data
The system displays an error message when the user enters invalid data
The system allows the user to reset their password after clicking the password reset link

tasks.title: Implement password reset logic with email notification
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle password reset requests and send email notifications

tasks.title: Create password reset page with user input fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the password reset page with user input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate password reset functionality with email API
tasks.description: Write API calls to handle password reset requests and integrate with the email service

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can access my account securely and easily
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, with proper validation and authorization
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects the user to the Google and GitHub authorization pages correctly
The system validates the OAuth authorization code and token correctly
The system logs the user in after successful OAuth authorization

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login logic with Google and GitHub
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle OAuth login requests and integrate with Google and GitHub APIs

tasks.title: Create OAuth login buttons for Google and GitHub
tasks.description: Design and implement the OAuth login buttons for Google and GitHub

tasks.title: Integrate OAuth login functionality with backend API
tasks.description: Write API calls to handle OAuth login requests and integrate with the backend authorization logic

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive welcome emails, so that I feel engaged with the platform
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to users when they sign up for the platform
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a welcome email to users within 1 minute of signing up
The welcome email contains the user's name and a link to get started with the platform
The welcome email is sent to the email address provided by the user during sign-up

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome emails
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for welcome emails using a templating engine

tasks.title: Integrate with SendGrid for sending welcome emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with SendGrid to send welcome emails to users

tasks.title: Test welcome email functionality
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure welcome emails are sent correctly

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive password reset links, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should send a password reset link to users when they request to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset link to users within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used to reset the user's password
The password reset link is sent to the email address associated with the user's account

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation
tasks.description: Write code to generate a password reset link that can be used to reset a user's password

tasks.title: Integrate with AWS SES for sending password reset emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with AWS SES to send password reset emails to users

tasks.title: Test password reset link functionality
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure password reset links are sent and work correctly

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive payment receipts, so that I can keep track of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt to users when they make a payment
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a payment receipt to users within 1 minute of making a payment
The payment receipt contains the payment amount, date, and a description of the transaction
The payment receipt is sent to the email address associated with the user's account

tasks.title: Implement payment receipt email template
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for payment receipts using a templating engine

tasks.title: Integrate with payment gateway to trigger payment receipt emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with the payment gateway to trigger payment receipt emails when a payment is made

tasks.title: Test payment receipt functionality
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure payment receipts are sent correctly

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive account notifications, so that I can stay informed about my account activity
stories.description: The system should send account notifications to users for important events such as account updates or suspicious activity
acceptance_criteria: The system sends account notifications to users within 1 minute of an important event occurring
The account notification contains a description of the event and any relevant details
The account notification is sent to the email address associated with the user's account

tasks.title: Implement account notification email template
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for account notifications using a templating engine

tasks.title: Integrate with account management system to trigger account notifications
tasks.description: Set up an integration with the account management system to trigger account notifications when an important event occurs

tasks.title: Test account notification functionality
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure account notifications are sent correctly

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to create, update, and delete user accounts
acceptance_criteria: The system allows admins to create new user accounts with unique usernames and passwords
The system allows admins to update existing user account information
The system allows admins to delete user accounts and prevent further access
The system prevents admins from creating duplicate user accounts

tasks.title: Design and implement user account creation functionality
tasks.description: Create a form for admins to input new user information and implement backend logic to create new accounts

tasks.title: Implement user account update functionality
tasks.description: Create a form for admins to update existing user information and implement backend logic to update accounts

tasks.title: Implement user account deletion functionality
tasks.description: Create a button for admins to delete user accounts and implement backend logic to remove accounts

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display key analytics metrics such as active users, revenue, and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays the number of active users on the platform
The system displays the total revenue generated by the platform
The system displays key system performance metrics such as response time and error rate
The system updates analytics metrics in real-time

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard layout
tasks.description: Create a visually appealing layout for the analytics dashboard

tasks.title: Implement analytics data retrieval and display
tasks.description: Write backend code to retrieve analytics data and display it on the dashboard

tasks.title: Implement real-time analytics updates
tasks.description: Write backend code to update analytics metrics in real-time

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display system health metrics such as error logs and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays error logs with detailed information about each error
The system displays system performance metrics such as CPU usage and memory usage
The system displays a system health score based on key metrics
The system sends notifications to admins when system health score falls below a certain threshold

tasks.title: Implement error log display and filtering
tasks.description: Write backend code to retrieve and display error logs with filtering options

tasks.title: Implement system performance metric display
tasks.description: Write backend code to retrieve and display system performance metrics

tasks.title: Implement system health score calculation and notification
tasks.description: Write backend code to calculate system health score and send notifications to admins

stories.title: As an admin, I want to configure platform settings, so that I can customize the platform to meet our needs
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to configure platform settings such as notification preferences and user roles
acceptance_criteria: The system allows admins to configure notification preferences such as email and in-app notifications
The system allows admins to configure user roles and permissions
The system saves and displays configured settings
The system prevents admins from configuring invalid settings

tasks.title: Design and implement settings configuration form
tasks.description: Create a form for admins to input and save platform settings

tasks.title: Implement settings validation and saving
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate and save configured settings

tasks.title: Implement settings display and editing
tasks.description: Write backend code to display and allow editing of configured settings

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time analytics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display real-time analytics metrics such as active users and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays real-time active user count
The system displays real-time system performance metrics
The system updates real-time analytics metrics every minute
The system displays historical real-time analytics data for the past hour

tasks.title: Implement real-time analytics data retrieval
tasks.description: Write backend code to retrieve real-time analytics data

tasks.title: Implement real-time analytics display
tasks.description: Write frontend code to display real-time analytics metrics

tasks.title: Implement historical real-time analytics data display
tasks.description: Write frontend code to display historical real-time analytics data
